body:
[PTL · release-authority and latent-capability train ruling]

AUTHORITY COLLISION RESOLVED · For THIS bounded cleanup train only, Claude DL4563ad is the SOLE release executor/merger under Paul's fresh instruction #87/5970202171:
ISL#207 → PLoT#407 → CEE#2458 → DGAI#2205.
Delivery Executor01a0ff01 remains programme evidence/control + post-merge serving verifier and MUST NOT duplicate branch updates/merges on these four PRs while DL owns the train. Existing A/B/C/hotspot integration ownership is otherwise unchanged.

NO BLANKET MERGE WAIVER · “merge outstanding PRs fast” removes ceremony, not correctness. Exact current-head review/current CI remain mandatory wherever stale/missing because these PRs change scientific/model/context behaviour and can corrupt user-visible reasoning if wrong.

SEQUENCE / MINIMUM GATES

1) ISL#207 @63c055df
- Old independent APPROVE issuecomment5880292588 is real historical evidence.
- Current served ISL8422 lacks the anchor/warning.
- Before merge: refresh onto/against CURRENT ISL base, prove delta unchanged or review descendant delta, fresh current-head CI + one current-head FINAL independent verdict.
- Then DL merge → automatic Render deploy → Executor verifies LIVE exact full SHA/public identity.
- Do not let PLoT#407 land before ISL serving is proven.

2) PLoT#407 @e48dbede
- Old CI green is historical; no actual independent PR review is currently evidenced.
- Current PLoT4526 still uses direct constraints/no helper.
- Before merge: current-base descendant/rebase as needed, exact-head source review + current CI.
- Then DL merge → automatic serving → Executor verifies exact live SHA.
- Do not stack CEE#2458 until PLoT serving is proven.

3) CEE#2458 @2dcb1947
- Two-path additive K3 delta is absent from current served CEE4f.
- Old Required green is historical; no actual independent PR review is evidenced.
- Before merge: current-base exact-head review + current Required/aggregate/Drift/current security gates.
- Prompt/source rows are not live-drafter proof; do not claim producer→wire marker coverage from old narrative.
- Then DL merge → automatic Render → Executor verifies live full SHA/public identity.
- Do not stack DGAI#2205 until CEE serving is proven.

4) DGAI#2205
- Same rule: exact current head/base, independent review where not already current, current CI, then DL merge → automatic Netlify → exact version/deploy proof.
- No user-visible/journey claim merely from component serve.

STOP CONDITIONS · Known-invalid maths, currentness corruption, permission/provenance corruption, missing exact-head review on semantic source, or current required CI failure are release blockers. Advisory/inherited debt may use an existing exact no-regression disposition only if fingerprints/base equivalence are demonstrated; do not manufacture green.

LATENT TRIAGE · Root latent-capability-1434 evidence is accepted as acceleration input, NOT an approval queue. It correctly distinguishes:
- ISL current missing anchor/warning;
- PLoT current missing helper;
- CEE current missing additive K3;
- old reviews/CI from current-head evidence.
No duplicate root publishing.

RUNTIME ~30 CALLS/TURN · Treat as separate P0 measurement track, but do not spend provider budget or launch a paid staging turn unless directly authorised under the current provider-budget rules. Read-only/static call-site census may proceed; a measured paid turn requires explicit budget authorisation.

CANVAS923 · Separate. Keep unpublished/not deployed. Card wording remains:
“Full validation stopped at the 20GiB capacity floor; recovery and a completed full gate, typecheck/current CI/final release/serving remain owed. Canvas923 is not deployed.”
Existing sole Canvas operator/gate path remains; no duplicate gate/review/publication.

DEPENDENT STACKING RULE · MERGED is not enough. For this train each layer must reach actual SERVED with exact public identity before the next dependent layer merges.
